Requires: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free (hand, battlefield)
Start: Spider-Gwen, Free Spirit (battlefield: without summoning sickness); Mind Over Matter (battlefield); Teferi's Ageless Insight (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You have a card in hand.
Steps: Tap Spider-Gwen using any free method.
  Spider-Gwen triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw two cards.
  Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Spider-Gwen.
  Repeat.
Notes: This combo will net near-infinite results from the method used to tap Spider-Gwen. The no summoning sickness requirement could also be bypassed depending on the method used.

## Combo 4067-6254-7064
Cards: Professor Zei, Anthropologist + Mind Over Matter + Vnwxt, Verbose Host
Color identity: UR | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite self-discard triggers; Infinite draw triggers; Near-infinite looting
Start: Professor Zei, Anthropologist (battlefield: without summoning sickness); Mind Over Matter (battlefield); Vnwxt, Verbose Host (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You have a card in hand.
  You have max speed.
Steps: Activate Professor Zei's first ability by tapping it and discarding a card, causing you to draw two cards due to Vnwxt.
  Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Professor Zei.
  Repeat.
